what_it_shows: The Forest View round pool with its blue tile border and steps, bright daylight, palm trees and the pool deck. Forest View Leisure Residences, Subic Bay.
notes: YouTube 'Forest View Leisure Residences - Subic Bay - Philippines' by Marcel Busine (94 s total). Cut from a single unbroken shot (20.2 s to 26.6 s; the source cuts roughly every 3.3 s, so 6.5 s is the longest clean shot), 720 px wide, muted. No presenter and no text in the cut. The source's other shots show the lobby with the FOREST VIEW sign and the villas, but a member of staff is at the desk in some of them, so they were not used. Poster = 23 s frame, 800 px wide. Rating 3/5.
